subject: sounds
title: Match the vowel sound
about: Hear a word and tap the word with the same vowel sound: the oo in moon, ou in cloud, oi in coin, aw in saw, ar, or, er, ai, oa and more. These are the sound teams CKLA teaches from Unit 2 to Unit 7, practiced here by ear only.
tip: Stretch the middle of both words and ask if they match.

cards.q: Which word has the same vowel sound as moon?
cards.note: moon and spoon have the same middle sound.
